theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_dqwe_bilinear_family_continuousAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (s : Rn n → Rn n) (A B : Rn n → Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x₀ : Rn n), IsOpen U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x P Q) U) → s x₀ ∈ U → ContinuousAt s x₀ → ContinuousAt A x₀ → ContinuousAt B x₀ → ContinuousAt (fun x => a (s x) (A x) (B x)) x₀
